ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course is restricted to participants in the Summer Academy for Teachers. This course begins July 25th and ends December 9th. From July 27 to August 8th, classes will be held at the College of Education. Meeting times are Monday through Thursday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and on Fridays from 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM:Elementary Education -UIUC, EDM:Scndry & Contng Educ -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
